observed: The new technician's column starts as Bravo Co, Delta Co.
After Reassign lead technician from the card's More actions, Aardvark Co goes to the bottom (Bravo, Delta, Aardvark), with the message and Undo, although by customer name it would come first.
After the lead is set on Abbey Co's work order page it also goes to the bottom (Bravo, Delta, Aardvark, Abbey).

Echo Co, dragged in between Bravo Co and Delta Co, lands there (Bravo, Echo, Delta, Aardvark, Abbey). Tech View shows the same order, and a second user signed in separately sees the same order in Tech View and Board View.
